title.help: Short title, e.g. 'High-Level Design - Sales Insight data platform'.

customer_name.help: Use the customer placeholder exactly as it appears in the notes.

project_name.help: Name of the customer's project or system, as used in the notes.

executive_summary.help: One paragraph, at most 120 words: the problem, what we propose, and the main business outcome.

background.help: At most 100 words: the current situation and why the change is needed now.

goals.help: 3 to 5 business goals, each with a measure a manager can check, e.g. 'Reports ready by 08:00 every day'.

in_scope.help: At most 6 items, in business wording.

out_of_scope.help: At most 5 items that a reader could otherwise assume are included.

solution_overview.help: At most 150 words, plain language: how the solution works end to end, without technical detail.

architecture_note.help: One sentence describing the summary diagram that is added by hand in Word.

components.help: 4 to 7 main building blocks. Service names are fine; purpose and value in one short line each.

why_this_approach.help: 3 or 4 reasons this design fits the customer, each one line.

security_operations.help: 3 to 5 lines at business level: access, data protection, backup and recovery, monitoring, compliance.

phases.help: 3 to 6 phases in order. Duration only from the notes, otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

costs.help: At most 5 rows, e.g. monthly cloud cost, one-time project effort. Figures only from the notes, otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

risks.help: 3 to 5 main risks. impact is high, medium or low.

next_steps.help: At most 5 actions or decisions, each naming who decides or acts.

open_questions.help: At most 5, the ones that matter most. impact is one of: price, scope, schedule, design, risk. List any others to the user only.

forbidden_patterns.name: resource count such as '2 x EC2'
